info.name: FitSync - Meal Tracking
info.description:
Meal Tracking API (Laravel 12 + Sanctum).

Run the folders in order with the Collection Runner (1 -> 7).
Seed first: php artisan migrate:fresh --seed (demo accounts use DemoPassword!123).
Note: otherAthleteId defaults to 2 (the seeded "other" athlete).

exec: // Start of today in Damascus (+03:00): never in the future, always on "today"
pm.test("has id + name", () => { pm.expect(d.meal_log_id).to.exist; pm.expect(d.name).to.eql("Grilled Chicken"); });
pm.test("calories updated, name kept", () => { pm.expect(Number(d.calories)).to.eql(520); pm.expect(d.name).to.eql("Grilled Chicken"); });
pm.test("active plan with meals", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d).to.be.an("array").that.is.not.empty; pm.expect(d[0].meals).to.be.an("array"); });
pm.test("has athlete_id + name", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d).to.be.an("array").that.is.not.empty; pm.expect(d[0]).to.have.all.keys("athlete_id","name","email"); });

item.name: Create overlapping plan for demo athlete (422)

exec: pm.test("target updated, title kept", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.daily_calories_target).to.eql(2100); pm.expect(d.title).to.eql("Cutting Plan"); });
